name: John Sale Manor
description: Apartments where HUD helps pay the rent, so what you pay is based on your income (116 such units).
eligibility: For older adults, based on income.

steps: Call 937-372-4143 to ask if the wait list is open.
Ask how to apply, and what to bring.
how_to_use.what_to_expect: Each building has its own wait list. Putting your name on several can help.
